systems.system: Numéro vert d'alerte pour signaler les cas de violence contre les enfants
systems.tiers: national alert line, stated by the UN country team to exist but to be non-functional

note: UN country team's review submission mentions police stations only for corporal punishment of children and police only as trainees in human rights; it states there is no national information system for gender-based violence nor any other system recording such cases, without saying who would keep it, and says nothing of how stations record reports or cases.
